bounds: One source, source-only and one named account route, two transport identities, descriptor presence and one admitted send. Separate cases request the source-only or named route. Repeated registration and removal may interleave with dispatch.

The leaf projection distinguishes internal, legacy and metadata-only registrations, exact and source-wide removal, fallback routing and the handler captured before the voice await. Plugin teardown ownership remains in PluginLifecycle. Post connectors, descriptor payload copying and non-send hooks are outside this projection.

Valid content follows the existing voice, sanitation and envelope pipeline. Cosmetic model failure and successful rewrite both resume the gate. Content-validation rejection is outside this projection. Fair progress requires the gate and selected handler to settle; a handler may reject. Unregister removes future lookup and does not cancel an admitted send. Runtime stop, transport disposal, provider delivery and persistence are outside this bound.
